classClosure.reason: The only self-triggered sends this change adds are bounded one-shots with explicit brakes, not controllers: the owner-only drop notice is one line per sender per 24h (in-memory memo, event-driven by an inbound message, never retried); the topic greeting is sent at most once per 24h while held and never again once its message id is persisted (a retry pins the stored id); the note buttons ride the existing once-per-cadence note (ChiefOfStaffLoop, PR 3, capped by noteCadenceHours and immediateMessagesPerDay). No restart/respawn/kill/retry path is added.
